#!/bin/bash
# Auto-generated wrapper for ssh.service
PIDFILE="/tmp/ssh.service.pid"
ORIG_CMD="/usr/sbin/sshd -D $SSHD_OPTS"
export KARE_WORKING_DIR=""

is_running() {
    pid=$(ps aux | grep "$ORIG_CMD" | grep -vE "grep|ssh.service.bin|tini" | awk '{print $2}'|head -n1)
    [ -n "$pid" ]
}

start() {
    if is_running; then
        echo "ssh.service already running (pid=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null))."
        exit 0
    fi
    /usr/bin/kare run openssh-server /usr/sbin/sshd -D $SSHD_OPTS 
    for i in {1..30}; do
        pid=$(ps aux | grep "$ORIG_CMD" | grep -vE "grep|ssh.service.bin|tini" | awk '{print $2}'|head -n1)
        [ -n "$pid" ] && break
        sleep 0.2
    done
    if [ -z "$pid" ]; then
        echo "Failed to start ssh.service"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "$pid" > "$PIDFILE"
    echo "$pid"
}

stop() {
    pids=$(ps aux | grep "$ORIG_CMD" | grep -vE "grep" | awk '{print $2}')
    kill -TERM $pids 2>/dev/null
    # 等待进程退出
    for i in {1..30}; do
        is_running || break
        sleep 0.2
    done
    is_running && kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
}

case "$1" in
    start)   start ;;
    stop)    stop ;;
    *)       echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
